name: Cape Leche
description:
An intense high with superior flavor, our Mystic Wax is a form of 100% concentrated cannabis created by whipping and agitating the extracted product. It has a fluffy, opaque texture that can range from buttery and light to dry and crumbly. Most commonly dabbed, but can be added to flower to increase potency and flavor.

Cape Leche is a sativa-dominant hybrid created by crossing Cape Poison with El Leche. Its dense, bright green buds are often highlighted with fiery orange pistils, giving the strain a visually striking appearance. The aroma is vibrant and sweet, combining tropical fruit notes with subtle earthy undertones, while the flavor delivers a smooth, creamy finish with a hint of citrus zest. Known for its uplifting and energizing effects, Cape Leche is prized for boosting creativity, motivation, and overall mood. Many users report a clear-headed, euphoric experience that helps combat fatigue and supports focus, making it ideal for daytime use. The strain’s stimulating properties are often paired with a gentle sense of relaxation, creating a balanced and approachable effect. Whether used for creative projects, social activities, or simply to enhance daily productivity, Cape Leche offers a bright, invigorating experience that leaves both mind and body feeling energized and inspired.

description:
Bred in collaboration with Purple City Genetics, Mango Mintality is a sativa-leaning strain that comes from crossing Mango Haze with Gush Mint. A truly delightful terpene profile led by β-Myrcene, trans-β-Ocimene, and β-Caryophyllene swirl classic aromas of earthy, spicy funk with ripe mangoes alongside flavors of creamy diesel. As you unpeel the mango, you may experience a strong physical wave while also potentially getting an upbeat feeling. Let the sweetness make way for stillness.

Cresco Premium Small Flower is ideal if you're looking to make larger purchases of the same strains you know and love. While small in size, Premium Small Flower has a similar potency to its full-sized counterparts.​ ​

Meticulously handcrafted using primo genetics and solventless extraction, this technique and approach has been practiced for centuries.

Ice, water, and fresh-frozen flower are mixed and agitated to separate the
trichomes, capturing a full profile of terpenes and cannabinoids. The resulting hash and water mixture is then freeze dried and allowed to cure, you know this product as bubble hash. The bubble hash is then gently warmed and worked by hand, opening up trichomes and releasing their potential. When the material becomes shiny, glossy, and soft to the touch, we carefully roll the hash into a 1g sized ball. Each Temple Ball boasts a deep and complex flavor profile, showcasing the raw potential of the plant. Indulge in the timeless art of hashish production with Hijinks Temple Balls, where tradition meets modern genetics.

-
Kush Pounder is sure to pack a punch. This strain has the classic OG smell and flavor, blending sweet earth with stinky dank funk. These buds are bright green with orange pistils and have a perfectly dense bud structure. Effects of this strain are equally powerful as they are pleasant. Kush Pounder is an indica dominant hybrid, making this strain perfect for those struggling with pain, anxiety, appetite loss, and nausea. The dominant terpenes for this strain are Caryophyllene, Limonene, and, Myrcene.
-
Beta-Caryophyllene is another terpene commonly found in a wide range of cannabis strains. This terpene is found in things like rosemary, oregano, and peppercorns, and has a peppery-spicy type of flavor. Beta-caryophyllene may assist with pain management and relaxation without the “couch lock” feeling.
-
Limonene is a terpene found in the rinds of citrus fruits, bergamot, and peppermint. This terpene has a citrusy and fruity aroma and flavor profile. Limonene may cause an uplift in mood, may help reduce stress, and promote relaxation.
-
Myrcene is the most abundant terpene found in cannabis and can be found in almost all cannabis strains to some degree. This terpene is found in things such as mangoes, lemongrass, thyme, and hops. This fruity, musky, mildly herbaceous terpene offers users overall body relaxation, cerebral euphoria, and may assist in pain management.

name: Big Lemons
description:
Roll back into history with hijinks Temple Ball. Renowned for their nostalgia and quality, Temple Balls are rooted in tradition and artisanal mastery aka "hashtery". Meticulously handcrafted using primo genetics and solventless extraction, this technique and approach has been practiced for centuries.

Ice, water, and fresh-frozen flower are mixed and agitated to separate the
trichomes, capturing a full profile of terpenes and cannabinoids. The resulting hash and water mixture is then freeze dried and allowed to cure, you know this product as bubble hash. The bubble hash is then gently warmed and worked by hand, opening up trichomes and releasing their potential. When the material becomes shiny, glossy, and soft to the touch, we carefully roll the hash into a 1g sized ball. Each Temple Ball boasts a deep and complex flavor profile, showcasing the raw potential of the plant. Indulge in the timeless art of hashish production with Hijinks Temple Balls, where tradition meets modern genetics.

name: Dancing Under the Moon
full_name: Dancing Under the Moon | hijinks - Temple Ball
description:
Roll back into history with hijinks Temple Ball. Renowned for their nostalgia and quality, Temple Balls are rooted in tradition and artisanal mastery aka "hashtery". Meticulously handcrafted using primo genetics and solventless extraction, this technique and approach has been practiced for centuries.

Ice, water, and fresh-frozen flower are mixed and agitated to separate the
trichomes, capturing a full profile of terpenes and cannabinoids. The resulting hash and water mixture is then freeze dried and allowed to cure, you know this product as bubble hash. The bubble hash is then gently warmed and worked by hand, opening up trichomes and releasing their potential. When the material becomes shiny, glossy, and soft to the touch, we carefully roll the hash into a 1g sized ball. Each Temple Ball boasts a deep and complex flavor profile, showcasing the raw potential of the plant. Indulge in the timeless art of hashish production with Hijinks Temple Balls, where tradition meets modern genetics.
